title: Qwen3-8B on 1x H100 SXM (GCP), pipeline validation
description: The runs used to build and debug the benchmark pipeline: BF16 performance, an accuracy re-run, and a full FP8 campaign, plus a smoke test. The code ran from uncommitted working trees; the exact code bundles (minus private Terraform state) are in the release.

title: Qwen3.8-27B on 1x H100 SXM 80GB (GCP a3-highgpu-1g Spot)
description: Serving performance of Qwen3.8-27B with vLLM 0.30.0 on one H100 SXM: BF16 (base checkpoint) and FP8 (Qwen's official FP8 checkpoint), six request shapes from short chat to 100k-token tool-calling agent contexts, latency percentiles and the most concurrent users served within the latency target. Performance only, plus a correctness suite for the 100k tool-calling scenario (long-context recall + a drift baseline); standard accuracy tests come later.
